name: branching-story-mcp
description: Zero-dependency MCP server exposing a deterministic branching-story state kernel (graph validation, guarded choice stepping, memory log, SHA-256 trace hash) and the CC-BY-4.0 2026 Consumer AI Story Continuity Benchmark (doi:10.7910/DVN/YEBHQR). Four read-only tools and two resources; stdio, no credentials, no network.

uvx.description: Run the PyPI package branching-story-mcp with uv (no install step, zero runtime dependencies)

tools.name: validate_story_graph
tools.description: Validate a branching-story-kit JSON scene graph. Checks the schema, detects missing choice targets, unreachable scenes, dead-end loops and invalid guard predicates, and returns structured diagnostics with issue codes, stats and a pass/fail verdict.

story.description: A branching-story-kit v1 story graph: {id?, title?, startScene (or legacy start), initialState?, scenes}. Scenes map id -> {title, body, ending?, choices?}. Choices carry label, next (or href), optional requires {key: minimum} and optional effects {key: value | {op: set|add|append|delete, value}}.

startScene.description: Alternative to `story`: the start scene id.

initialState.description: Alternative to `story`: the initial state vector.

tools.name: step_story_state
tools.description: Run the deterministic story-state reducer for one or more player choices. Evaluates `requires` guards, applies `set` / `add` / `append` effects through a single write path, and returns the next scene, updated state, fired guards, available choices and a turn-stamped memory trace with a verifiable SHA-256 trace hash.

story.description: A branching-story-kit v1 story graph (see validate_story_graph).

choices.description: Ordered player choices. Each entry is an integer index into the current scene's choices, a case-insensitive choice label, or {index}/{label}.

state.description: Optional state overrides applied on top of initialState.

memory.description: Optional prior memory log: strings or {turn, fact} objects.

remember.description: Facts to plant in the turn-stamped memory log before stepping.

startScene.description: Optional override for the entry scene.

tools.name: query_ai_story_benchmark
tools.description: Query the verified Nov 15 2026 10-Platform Consumer AI Story Continuity Benchmark (doi:10.7910/DVN/YEBHQR) with an optional `platform` or `status` filter. Returns structured JSON plus full APA/BibTeX citation and the interactive benchmark explorer URL.

tools.name: detect_state_drift
tools.description: Given a planted fact {key, expected_value, planted_turn} and a transcript of turns, check deterministic recall / contradiction / omission and classify the session against the five-mode silent state drift taxonomy (F1 silent state loss, F2 session non-persistence, F3 gating censoring, F4 transient service degradation, F5 platform delisting) from doi:10.5281/zenodo.24549412.

planted_turn.description: 1-based turn where the fact was planted.

wrong_values.description: Values that would contradict the planted fact.

aliases.description: Accepted spellings of the expected value.

probe_turn.description: Turn at which recall is probed (default: last turn).

min_gap.description: Minimum turns after planting before a session counts as probed (default 2).

delisted.description: Set true when the platform was delisted (forces F5).

resources.name: 2026-10-platform-matrix
resources.description: Full CC-BY-4.0 per-platform matrix (evaluation date 2026-11-15, doi:10.7910/DVN/YEBHQR): status, turns completed, turn-15 recall, TTFS, latency, ads, signup gate, failure mode and notes for all 10 platforms.

resources.name: story-graph-v1
resources.description: Canonical JSON Schema for branching-story-kit scene graphs (scenes, startScene, initialState).

examples.title: Validate a branching story
examples.description: Check a story graph for missing targets and unreachable scenes
examples.prompt: Validate this branching story graph and list any errors or warnings.

examples.title: Step a story
examples.description: Apply reader choices and return the resulting state and trace hash
examples.prompt: Apply the choices Hold his gaze, then Ask about the folio, to this story and show the final state and available choices.

examples.title: Query the benchmark
examples.description: Look up which platforms failed turn-15 recall in the 2026 benchmark
examples.prompt: Which platforms in the 2026 Consumer AI Story Continuity Benchmark failed the turn-15 recall probe?

examples.title: Detect state drift
examples.description: Classify a transcript against a planted fact
examples.prompt: Check this transcript for drift of the fact that my cat is called Marmalade, planted at turn 2 and probed at turn 4.
